entries.head: head for

senses.en: to move toward a place

example.en: Let's head for the gate — boarding starts in ten minutes.
example.zh: 我们去登机口吧，十分钟后开始登机。

entries.l1_note: 中文“去机场”直译成 go to the airport 没错，但口语里 head for 更像“出发往那边走”。

entries.head: end up

senses.en: to finally be in a place or situation you did not plan

example.en: We took the wrong exit and ended up in a parking lot.
example.zh: 我们出错了口，最后开进了一个停车场。

entries.l1_note: 中文“结果”常被译成 as a result，口语里 end up 更自然，而且后面直接跟地点或 doing。
collocations: end up in the wrong place

entries.head: turn around

senses.en: to change direction and go the other way

example.en: You missed the turn — just turn around at the next light.
example.zh: 你错过路口了，下个红绿灯掉头就行。

entries.l1_note: 掉头是 turn around；turn back 是折返不去了。

entries.head: turn onto

senses.en: to move onto a different road

example.en: Turn onto the side street after the bank and you'll see the gate.
example.zh: 过了银行拐进小路就能看到大门。

entries.l1_note: 拐上某条路是 turn onto，不是 turn to（转向某人）。

entries.head: veer off

senses.en: to move suddenly away from a straight path

example.en: The bike veered off the path and into the grass.
example.zh: 自行车一下偏离小路冲进草地。

entries.l1_note: veer off 是突然偏离，不是慢慢转（turn）。

entries.head: get to

senses.en: to arrive at a place

example.en: How do I get to the nearest subway station?
example.zh: 最近的地铁站怎么走？

entries.l1_note: 到达是 get to，不是 get（少了 to）；home 例外：get home。

entries.head: get lost

senses.en: to lose your way

example.en: We got lost three times before we found the hotel.
example.zh: 我们迷路三次才找到酒店。

entries.l1_note: 迷路是 get lost，不是 lose the way（中式）。

entries.head: double back

senses.en: to go back in the direction you came from

example.en: We doubled back to the corner where we saw the sign.
example.zh: 我们原路折回看到指示牌的那个路口。

entries.l1_note: double back 是原路返回找东西，不是 turn around（掉头）。
collocations: double back on the same road

entries.head: cut through

senses.en: to go through a place to save time

example.en: Let's cut through the mall — it's faster than the crosswalk.
example.zh: 从商场穿过去吧，比走人行横道快。

entries.l1_note: 抄近路穿过是 cut through，不是 cut across（横穿）。

entries.head: cut across

senses.en: to go across an area rather than around it

example.en: Don't cut across the lawn — there's a path on the left.
example.zh: 别横穿草坪，左边有路。

entries.l1_note: cut across 是横穿一片区域；穿建筑走近路是 cut through。

entries.head: walk down

senses.en: to walk along a street or path

example.en: Walk down this street for two blocks and turn right.
example.zh: 沿这条街走两个路口再右转。

entries.l1_note: 沿着街走是 walk down / walk along，不是 walk on。

entries.head: go past

senses.en: to move past a place

example.en: Go past the pharmacy and the building is on your left.
example.zh: 走过药店，楼就在你左手边。

entries.l1_note: 经过是 go past，不是 pass by 才能用；两个都常见。

entries.head: go along

senses.en: to continue along a road or path

example.en: Go along this road until you hit the river.
example.zh: 沿这条路一直走到河边。

entries.l1_note: go along 是沿路走；go along with 是同意、配合。

entries.head: come to

senses.en: to reach a place while moving

example.en: When you come to a fork, keep left.
example.zh: 走到岔路口时走左边。

entries.l1_note: come to 是走到；come to 还有“醒来、合计”的意思。

entries.head: cross over

senses.en: to go to the other side of a street

example.en: Cross over at the lights and the exit is right there.
example.zh: 在红绿灯过到对面就是出口。

entries.l1_note: 过到对面是 cross over；cross 单独也可，但 over 更明确。

entries.head: point out

senses.en: to show someone where something is

example.en: He pointed out the building behind the trees.
example.zh: 他指了指树后面的那栋楼。

entries.l1_note: 指出是 point out，不是 point（指一下）。

entries.head: look for

senses.en: to try to find something

example.en: I'm looking for the entrance to the parking lot.
example.zh: 我在找停车场的入口。

entries.l1_note: 找东西是 look for；找到是 find。中文一个“找”对应两个词。

entries.head: ask for

senses.en: to request something or ask where something is

example.en: Ask for the north exit — the south one is closed.
example.zh: 问北出口，南边那个关了。

entries.l1_note: 问路是 ask for directions；ask about 是问情况。

entries.head: ask around

senses.en: to ask several people for information

example.en: I asked around and someone said the bus stops behind the mall.
example.zh: 我问了几个人，有人说公交站在商场后面。

entries.l1_note: 四处打听是 ask around，不是 ask everywhere（中式）。

entries.head: work out

senses.en: to find a solution or understand something

example.en: We finally worked out which exit to take.
example.zh: 我们终于搞清楚该走哪个出口。

entries.l1_note: work out 也指健身；这里是“想明白”。

entries.head: wind up

senses.en: to end up somewhere after a complicated route

example.en: We took three wrong turns and wound up at the airport.
example.zh: 我们走错三次，最后绕到了机场。

entries.l1_note: wind up 是“最后落在”，和 end up 同义；wind up 也指结束。
collocations: wind up at the wrong place

entries.head: lead to

senses.en: when a path or road goes to a place

example.en: This corridor leads to the east exit.
example.zh: 这条走廊通向东西出口。

entries.l1_note: lead to 是通向，也指导致结果；lead on 是误导。

entries.head: open onto

senses.en: when a door or window leads directly to a place

example.en: The back door opens onto a small courtyard.
example.zh: 后门一开就是个小院子。

entries.l1_note: 门通向某处是 open onto，不是 open to（那是“对……开放”）。

entries.head: head back

senses.en: to start going back to where you came from

example.en: We missed the turn, so we headed back to the intersection.
example.zh: 我们错过路口，只好往回走到十字路口。

entries.l1_note: 往回走是 head back；head for 是前往。

entries.head: turn back

senses.en: to stop going forward and return

example.en: The road was flooded, so we turned back.
example.zh: 路被淹了，我们就折返了。

entries.l1_note: turn back 是放弃前进往回走；turn around 是掉头后继续走。

entries.head: pull in

senses.en: to drive into a place and stop

example.en: Pull in at the next gas station — I need a bathroom.
example.zh: 下个加油站拐进去，我要上厕所。

entries.l1_note: pull in 是拐进去停；pull over 是靠边停。
collocations: pull in to the parking lot

entries.head: pull out

senses.en: to drive out of a place onto the road

example.en: A car pulled out right in front of me.
example.zh: 一辆车突然从我前面开出来。

entries.l1_note: pull out 是驶出；pull out of 也指退出（交易）。

entries.head: go by

senses.en: to pass a place while traveling

example.en: We went by the old market on the way here.
example.zh: 来的路上我们路过了老市场。

entries.l1_note: go by 也指“按……判断”，比如 go by the map。

entries.head: pass by

senses.en: to go past something or someone

example.en: You'll pass by a school before you see the bridge.
example.zh: 你会先经过一所学校，然后才看到桥。

entries.l1_note: pass by 是经过；pass by 也可指时间流逝。

entries.head: come up to

senses.en: to approach someone or something

example.en: A guy came up to me and asked if I was lost.
example.zh: 一个小伙子走过来问我是不是迷路了。

entries.l1_note: 走到跟前是 come up to；come up 是出现、临近。
